+++ src/sdk/README.md

 ```
 
-If the snapshot has not arrived within 1.5 seconds (configurable), `onDecisions` receives `null` and
-your defaults stand. A late snapshot is still applied when it lands. The page never waits on us.
+On failure or the 1.5-second deadline (configurable), slot subscribers receive `[]` with the requested
+page, `onDecisions` receives `null`, and `current()` becomes `null`. Capture from the previous delivery
+is cancelled; default rendering does not create an impression. A later slot subscriber receives that
+known absence too; subscribing before any delivery remains silent. A successful empty set remains a set.
+The latest `hydrate()` or `apply()` supersedes older requests and timers. A timed-out request may still
+apply its own late result if nothing newer has superseded it.
 
+Render your own defaults at first paint and restore them on `[]`; report `rendered()` only after the
+selected content is actually painted. Asynchronous `hydrate()` may repaint defaults, so it is not a
+no-flash guarantee. `listen.apply(serverPayload)` can accept an existing server-provided `DecisionSet`,
+but its identity/page correctness, safe embedding and first-paint timing are the site's integration work.
+
 ## The four capture paths
 ```
